tested_hypotheses: Unconditional ATK bonus applies to all wearer hits across all damage types and skills.
QTE Support Skill hits gain an additive Crit DMG bonus equal to buff_GoldRecord_QteCritDmaUp.
Each Support Skill damage hit adds 1 stack of Ultimate Crit DMG bonus (+buff_GoldRecord_QCritDmaUp per stack) up to 3 stacks.
The Ultimate Crit DMG stack buff lasts 3.0s and resets its remaining duration upon obtaining additional stacks (RefreshPolicy::Reset, AllAtOnce).
Ultimate hits consume no stacks and gain the full additive Crit DMG bonus of current stacks.
QTE admission is modeled via InputActionRole::Qte; native QTE triggers are outside scope.
